sources.feature_id: FID 790; BUILDING_N Pi Kappa Alpha; BLDG_ABBR SOPKA; address 629 University St; owner GREEK
sources.source_date: Undocumented in feature attributes; service describes Purdue buildings
sources.measurement_method: Inverse Web Mercator to WGS84 then project-local approximation documented in modular/AGENTS.md: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040. Compare polygon plan boundary to OSM way 301841252.
sources.result: 13-point ring; converted bounds X -285.869..-271.581 m, Y 382.365..424.921 m; projected area 537.674 m2. Feature Shape__Area is not treated as metric truth because its units/semantics are not documented.
sources.uncertainty: Identity and horizontal location are strongly supported by name/address and footprint overlap. GIS floor fields (NUM_LEVELS=1, CountOfFLO=1) conflict with the three visible storeys in chapter imagery. Extrution=29 has no documented unit and is not used as a measured height.

sources.title: Way 301841252
sources.source_date: Way last edited 2022-02-22T03:04:07Z; current snapshot retrieved 2026-10-26
sources.measurement_method: Transform vertices with the project's documented local approximation and compare polygon boundaries (symmetric Hausdorff distance via planar geometry).
sources.result: Compared with Purdue FID 790, boundary Hausdorff distance 0.446 m; centroid offset 0.368 m; areas 544.729 m2 OSM and 537.674 m2 Purdue GIS. The OSM tags alone do not establish fraternity identity; address and Purdue GIS name do.
sources.uncertainty: This is community-mapped, not a survey. Footprints are close but differ at sub-metre scale; Purdue GIS ring is used as the model wall outline.

sources.title: Completed Chapter House Renovations: Chapter House photograph
sources.source_date: Image uploaded 2023-09; photo exposure date undocumented
sources.measurement_method: Visual inspection for visible building identity and facade/roof features only.
sources.result: Visible long red-brick facade, three storeys, repeated white-framed/shuttered windows, four-column white classical portico, triangular pediment and lettering, centered entry with smaller door hood and entry steps, shallow gray metal roof.
sources.uncertainty: Single front elevation photo; scale, height, side/rear facade and exact roof pitch cannot be measured from this image.

sources.feature_id: Beta Phi chapter-house description in 1965 issue
sources.measurement_method: Historical text/search-indexed page describes an 80-man house at the Stadium Avenue / University Street / Stadium Mall intersection on a quarter city block.
sources.result: Supports scale and campus location history; not used as measured geometry or exact facade plan.

modeling_decisions.footprint: Purdue FID 790 structural polygon converted into the project's campus coordinate frame; no XY rescaling or hand-drawn footprint change.
modeling_decisions.orientation: Official polygon orientation retained. East facade detailed as the photographed front; exact facing direction is inferred from address/street context and GIS footprint.
modeling_decisions.vertical_geometry: Three visible levels are modeled with a 9.1 m wall/eave and 10.75 m roof ridge, estimates. No measured elevation was available.
modeling_decisions.roof: Shallow hipped metal roof with modest overhang, estimated from the front photograph.
modeling_decisions.facade: Red brick, white shuttered sash windows, four-column central portico, white pediment with chapter lettering, centered entry and steps, all supported qualitatively by the 2023 chapter image.
modeling_decisions.unpictured_facades: Rear and end windows are conservative extrapolations, explicitly lower confidence than front facade.

validation.source_identity: Purdue FID 790 name/address and current chapter official webpage match; OSM address/geometry corroborate location.
validation.source_conflict: GIS floor count attributes say 1 while official chapter photo shows three visible levels; image is used for apparent story count while GIS height fields remain untrusted.
validation.registration: Footprint boundary Hausdorff 0.446 m to OSM; centroid offset 0.368 m; transformed GIS bounds are within 0.4 m of the current OSM-derived massing envelope.
validation.remaining_uncertainty: No surveyed wall footprint, dimensional elevations, measured height, roof plan/pitch, or rear/side elevation evidence.
